t: You're looking at Brixton Library, a public library in the London Borough of Lambeth. It was built in the 1890s and is Grade II listed. The sugar magnate Sir Henry Tate commissioned it. Tate was also a philanthropist, and is known for establishing the Tate Gallery and Henry Tate & Sons, which later became Tate & Lyle. The architect was Sidney R. J. Smith, a Late Victorian who worked for Tate through the 1880s and 1890s, including on the original Tate Gallery at Millbank.
